description: Amazon S3 on Outposts provides access to S3 on Outposts operations
name: s3outposts

subcommands.description: Creates an endpoint and associates it with the specified Outpost.  It can take up to 5 minutes for this action to finish.   Related actions include:    DeleteEndpoint     ListEndpoints
subcommands.name: create-endpoint

options.description: The ID of the Outposts
options.name: --outpost-id

options.description: The ID of the subnet in the selected VPC. The endpoint subnet must belong to the Outpost that has Amazon S3 on Outposts provisioned
options.name: --subnet-id

options.description: The ID of the security group to use with the endpoint
options.name: --security-group-id

options.description: The type of access for the network connectivity for the Amazon S3 on Outposts endpoint. To use the Amazon Web Services VPC, choose Private. To use the endpoint with an on-premises network, choose CustomerOwnedIp. If you choose CustomerOwnedIp, you must also provide the customer-owned IP address pool (CoIP pool).   Private is the default access type value
options.name: --access-type

options.description: The ID of the customer-owned IPv4 address pool (CoIP pool) for the endpoint. IP addresses are allocated from this pool for the endpoint
options.name: --customer-owned-ipv4-pool
